keywords: The Appellant challenged the District Court’s treatment of the proceeds from three mahogany trees cut from the partitioned land, claiming entitlement to the money deposited in court. Held - the District Judge had directed the value of plantations and improvements to be distributed proportionately among the parties and noted the Appellant’s own admission supporting proportional division. Appeal dismissed without costs.
